Author: Wormzey
Name: [TPlog] Stray Apocalypse Paths
Punchline: Draws the whole path of Kefka's Stray Apocalypse explosions as soon as each line starts casting.
Description: In Dancing Mad (Ultimate), each Stray Apocalypse starter fires six more explosions in a straight diagonal line, one every half second. The game only marks the starter. This plugin draws all six follow-up circles on the ground the moment the starter begins casting, and removes each one once it has gone off.
